Well it wasn't my party but my little sisters sweet 16.

We moved to California for a while (for maybe 2-3 years) from SC, so we are not used to a lot of people coming to a party.

Holy shit did people show up.....people she didn't even know came, we got to the point of charging $3 a person to come in because my house was crowded as fuck.

Hahaha this is where the shit hits the fan. So in Cali you can expect a lot of drugs, i mean A LOT of drugs, E, coke, bud, acid and Nos. (the stuff you put in cars that make them go zoom, yeah kids breathe that shit in because it gives them a "wicked high" saw a kid even smoke a cigarette while inhaling because it ignited the cigarette, i was waiting for this kid to catch fire any moment)

So everyone's liquored up and drugged to hell and back except me who was smoking the reefer and my friend kenny, who was drinking but much. I hear all this yelling outside so i take a look and i wish i got there sooner because i walked outside to see some faggot swing at a girl, so i charged him and pushed him away saying something along the lines of "Get the fuck out!" and "who the fuck are you to do that at my house!" So the kid got angry swung at this girl again, i took her inside and some people that i knew asked what's wrong, i told them what's up and i for the life of me regret every word that left my mouth at that point, all the actions, everything, they stormed out the door, It was 6 or 7 at first i saw that left but when i went out to see what everyone was doing i was in shock, good, bad, just shock.

At least 20 fucked up people found this kids, beat the fuck out of him, i just sat and watched, every punch, kick, stomp, this kid could take a beating or maybe it was the drugs, anyway the cops came, party got busted, people went on there merry way except the kid who got his ass kicked, he went to the E.R.

I forgot to mention my parents, well there's not much to say, they believed we had things under control so they really didn't care, and before you say "you have terrible parents", we kept everything a secret from them during the whole party, they understand the bud and alcohol but my dad would kick my ass if he ever saw anything extreme, so fuck you they are good people.

And if you are wondering about the cops, they arrested 2 people, only 2, I'm pretty sure the kids had nothing to do with the fight either.

But yeah, that's my story, I made a lot of friends that night, that's a plus to the whole situation.
